requirement.value: Butcher, Blackguard (Darkblade) or Mutant mastery + Vismagus

system.description: When you perform a Ritual you cannot fully afford, pay part of its Mind Point cost with Hit Points at 2 HP per 1 MP — never down to 0 HP. A Ritual paid for this way heals neither you nor any ally who supported its Magic Check (it works normally on any other target). Vismagus may be part-paid the same way, its other restrictions intact.
